Entity Framework Core support for Fixtura: point any registered DbContext at a test database in one call, whatever its registration shape (plain, pooled, factory or pooled factory), keep or drop the app's own options such as interceptors, and reach contexts a library keeps internal.

Compose ASP.NET Core integration-test hosts from reusable features on top of WebApplicationFactory: typed service swaps, settings as objects that replace whole arrays, test users signed in through the app's own JWT or cookie authentication, and infrastructure that skips tests locally and fails them…

SQL Server in a Docker container for Fixtura test hosts: one container per test run, started on first use and shared by every fixture, each with its own databases. Without Docker the fixture's tests skip with the reason; with the "required" variable set, as in CI, they fail.

SQL Server for Fixtura test hosts: a server from an environment variable or LocalDB, one prefixed database per name per fixture, dropped when the fixture is done. Without a server the fixture's tests skip with the reason; with the "required" variable set, as in CI, they fail.
